title: Electric press brakes
subtitle: Servo ball-screw press brakes 11 – 176 US tons × 20″ – 10.5 ft · compact 3 – 13 ton bench machines · robot bending cells
cover_line: NovoTech value line · built in China to North American standards · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with European and Japanese controls and hydraulics — Delem, Estun, Schneider, Siemens, NOK — inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, as every machine we sell.

The electric press brakes drive the ram with servo motors through timing belts and dual lead ball screws: no oil, no pump idling between bends, no valves to drift — ± 0.01 mm repeatability from the first part, programmable bending speed to 30 mm/s and about 70 % less energy than a hydraulic brake. Ten models from 11 US tons × 20″ to 176 US tons × 10.5 ft with a Delem DA-53T control and X-R servo back gauge, three bench-size 3, 6 and 12 ton machines for small parts, and robot bending cells on the 40 and 50 ton machines.
